High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Dinesh Tripathi - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Chimanlal Sethi - Advocate for the respondent.
On hearing learned counsel for the parties, it is apparent that parties have not complied with the terms of settlement drawn in mediation.
As per learned counsel for the applicant, applicant is ready to produce bank draft of Rs.3.00 lac within one month from today.
Upon producing DD of Rs.3.00 lac, parties shall file an application for divorce with mutual consent.
After four months of filing application for mutual consent new DD of same amount will be filed as validity of DD is only for three months.
Before recording final statement in application under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act before the Family Court, DD of Rs.3.00 lac will be placed before the Family Court.
After recording statement of both the parties with regard to mutual consent for divorce, Family Court shall hand over the DD to the wife.
If the applicant fails to comply with the directions, the proceedings, if any, stayed by the Court pending under Section 498A of IPC and Section 125 of Cr.P.C. shall commence in accordance with law.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Jasleen Shrinivas Tripathi vs Smt. Aparna Tripathi on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108287695/
